findings.title: The permanent SQL-expression disablement has no regression coverage
findings.body: This PR changes no test files, so there is no test that verifies a `QueryTypeSQL` query is rejected when `FlagSqlExpressions` is enabled. That is the primary security boundary here: `enableSqlExpressions` intentionally returns false in both toggle states. Add coverage for the enabled-toggle case (and the legacy `UnmarshalSQLCommand` path, which is disabled through the stub DB) so a future cleanup cannot inadvertently re-enable the RCE/LFI-prone implementation.

findings.title: The error message and retained feature-toggle documentation misstate the feature status
findings.body: SQL expressions are now deliberately disabled regardless of the `sqlExpressions` feature toggle, but this reports only that they are "not implemented." Operators who have enabled the documented toggle will receive a misleading error and have no indication that their configuration is intentionally ignored due to the security removal. Update the user-facing error and feature-toggle documentation to state that SQL expressions are disabled/removed and, where appropriate, reference the security advisory.
